history: Retain the criterion, exact claim, coverage row, transition or publication defect, the changed analysis, and reassessment. Never duplicate a content-addressed object or head update.

onFail.instruction: Ask for the malformed request field.

items.expect: Declared authority and evidence files match digests.

onFail.instruction: Ask for the missing or changed evidence file.

items.expect: The exact promise restatement is explicitly confirmed before modeling.

onFail.instruction: Present the restatement and ask for confirmation or correction; publish nothing.

items.expect: Claims are role-separated and every fact binds source and head.

onFail.instruction: Correct or remove the named unsupported claim; unresolved contradiction blocks.

items.expect: Every dimension and consumer has one valid disposition.

onFail.instruction: Repair the named missing, duplicate or unsupported matrix row.

items.expect: Lifecycle and content-addressed publication are legal, exact and feature-scoped.

onFail.instruction: Record the transition or authority conflict and publish no head.
Repair only the response shape; do not republish.

items.expect: The response binds the request revision.

onFail.instruction: Correct the request binding; do not republish.

items.expect: Output artifacts are scoped and digest-bound.

onFail.instruction: Repair the invalid artifact record without republishing.
Correct the invalid observation without republishing.

items.expect: Feature, promise, target state and required dimensions are available.

onFail.instruction: Ask for the exact missing business authority input.

items.expect: Required source and publication capabilities are available.

onFail.instruction: Name the unavailable capability and publish nothing.

items.expect: Transient execution completes without duplicate publication.

onFail.instruction: Re-read the content address and current head, then perform only a missing idempotent publication action.

stopWhen: Return done only when every criterion passes and the exact accepted head is published once. After two failed feedback rounds, missing confirmation, or authority conflict, return blocked or mismatch with concrete defects and publish nothing new.
